comment: The refusal-identity and outcome-tag table, generated from the bumbledb-log enums by `cargo run -p bumbledb-log --bin identities` (src/identities.rs): one array per boundary enum, refusal kinds spelled by each enum's `identity()`, outcome arms spelled as the tags consumers narrow. crates/bumbledb-log/conformance/v3/identities.json and ts/crate/log-identities.json are both this emission — the in-crate golden pins the conformance copy, the census regeneration lane diffs both — and the bridge marshal refuses to cross any kind outside its family row.
